messages:
Sam (oncall): prod eu-west2 503s incoming, inference tail latency exploding. autoscaler not adding GPUs, queue depth > 300 requests.
Maya (infra): seeing a flood of provisioner errors -> cloud API 429 + quotaExceeded on create. also multiple node bootstrap timeouts.
Jia (sre): autoscaler logs: 'scaleUp attempt failed: no compatible nodes: capacityUnavailable' then 'backoff 8s'. thrash between attempt/backoff.
Marco (runtime): runtime shows long model shard download times when new nodes join -> startup ~90s. combined with backoff that's killing headroom.
Sam (oncall): quick paste of relevant lines:
```
2026-03-18T09:05:11Z provisioner: CreateNode -> 429 QuotaExceeded (GPUs)
2026-03-18T09:05:20Z autoscaler: scaleUp failed, backoff=4s
2026-03-18T09:06:02Z cloud-provisioner: node 12 preempted (spot). reason: capacity_notification
```
Maya (infra): looks like a subtle cross-region capacity wobble: eu-west2 spot pools got reclaimed and our quota for on-demand in that project is low. Provisioner retries + spot evictions -> oscillation.
Jia (sre): confirming: kubelet bootstrap errors show network handshake timeouts too (tarball pull slow). suspect regional network degradation made image pull + shard download exceed readinessTimeout.
Marco (runtime): runtime warming (prefix cache) is also triggering downloads on new nodes. we should disable full shard sync on join or use cached snapshots.
infra-bot: emergency-runbook triggered: "scale-failover-regional" assigned to Maya & Sam.
Maya (infra): immediate mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic from eu-west2 -> eu-west1/us-west1 via traffic-shift playbook, 2) increase on-demand quota request and open cloud ticket for spot capacity anomaly, 3) mark eu-west2 spot pools as unschedulable to avoid thrash, 4) start a small reserved on-demand pool (temp).
Sam (oncall): executing traffic shift now. will flip route weight 70% -> eu-west1, 30% -> us-west1.
Jia (sre): running command to cordon spot nodes and taint them to stop new pods landing:
```bash
kubectl get nodes -l pool=eu-west2-spot -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl cordon
kubectl label nodes -l pool=eu-west2-spot drained-by=incident-1709001123
```
Sam (oncall): cloud-provisioner-bot shows one on-demand create in progress, stuck at creating VM image. cloud team pinged (ticket #CL-9921).
cloud-provisioner-bot: createInstance api -> 429 (rate limit), queued for retry.
Maya (infra): decision: temp spin a small Dedicated-like on-demand pool in eu-west1 under a different project/account where we have spare quota (costly but necessary). I'll approve cost.
Marco (runtime): also toggling runtime join behavior: set startup-grace=180s and disable immediate shard download to avoid readiness flapping. pushing config change to canary nodes.
Sam (oncall): traffic shift in progress, error rate in eu-west2 down 55% after 6 mins. overall 503s dropping.
Jia (sre): monitoring shows autoscaler backoff decay; once warm nodes join, queue drains. watch for thrash when spot pools become available again.
Maya (infra): cost note — temporary on-demand pool will add ~ $12k/day if sustained. will need billing flag + exec approval for >24h.
Sam (oncall): summarizing actions done: traffic shifted, spot nodes cordoned, canary runtime config pushed, cloud ticket opened, temp on-demand pool requested.
Marco (runtime): opened ticket to add fast-cache snapshotting to reduce join time; long-term fix.
Maya (infra): assign followups: postmortem owner Jia, quota escalation Maya, runtime optimization Marco. we'll sync in 30m.
Sam (oncall): thanks team. will keep channel updated. :thumbsup:
